title: Adopt operating levels plus individually selectable FA3 applications
decision: Use one FA3 175-capability platform and separate operating scale from application entitlement.
Support MINIMAL, PERSONAL, PROFESSIONAL, STUDIO, BUSINESS and ENTERPRISE operating levels.
Allow individually selectable applications through Enterprise; higher operating level does not automatically grant more applications.
Treat domain packs as optional bundles only, never technical dependencies.
Automatically include required platform/shared dependencies without granting unrelated user-facing application entitlements.
Continuously reconcile existing, in-progress, planned and future applications.
